profile.headline: Software Engineer | Android Development | Full Stack
profile.summary: Software engineer with 4 years experience in Android apps, 2 years experience in web application, and 4 years experience in Android firmware.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in the Accessibility team at Meta Reality Labs, focusing on inclusive XR experiences for blind and low vision users in Meta Quest
	•	Delivered new accessibility features, including Text-to-Speech and Screen Reader, making Meta Quest more inclusive and accessible to all users, particularly blind and low-vision users.
	•	Contributed to the open-source Unity Accessibility Plugin, helping third-party developers easily integrate accessibility features into their Unity-based apps.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Unity · Mixed Reality · Gen AI · Java · Kotlin · C++ · C# · Java Native Interface (JNI)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in the Guardians team for the Android Google App (AGA), where I focused on user data compliance (e.g., DMA, AADC, GDPR regulations) and user privacy and security, and improved user interfaces / user experience in the App.

- Contributed to DMA isolation and logging workstreams – removed 10+ disallowed dependencies to meet DMA requirements; cleaned up the deprecated Incognito Mode by removing 20k+ lines of code, reducing APK size by 550 KB; refactored loggers in 20+ Dagger bindings and 40+ test files, correctly relabelling ~260 billion daily log events.

- Contributed to AI Generative (Magi) search experience in AGA – launched 3 new peek UIs for Ambient Converse and MCF Notes projects; introduced 4 new AppFlow logging events and migrated 6 required Silk APIs into Ambient Converse to improve search experience; conducted 2 live experiments for server loading improvement.

- Led the Trustometer project, collected 100k+ user feedback by developing a lightweight trust surveys UI components. 

- Led the Pierce project, enhancing user experience by blocking 6M+ restricted accounts from signing in AGA, ensuring GDPR compliance, and reinforcing user trust.

- Successfully launched 6 new setting items to meet AADC regulations, and migrated 5 legacy setting pages into the new TNG:Settings framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Data Structures · Algorithms · Android SDK · Mobile Application Development · Android Testing · Android · Software Development · Front-end Development · Kotlin · SQL · Android Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on web application development for both back-end RESTful APIs and front-end web portals.

- Developed new features in MCM6 web portals using Angular 5 and Spring Boot frameworks, along with technologies including Typescript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, and jQuery, and tools including Maven, Gradle, Docker, and Tomcat.

- Designed and developed 20+ critical RESTful APIs by using .NET Core 6 framework and C#, maintained 10+ schemas and stored procedures on SQL servers, and refactored 10k+ lines of codes for system health.

- Coordinated the CI/CD pipelines across DevOps, QA, Eng, and Operations team for 10+ release cycles.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · Docker Products · Web Development · Gradle · JavaScript · HTML · Java · RESTful WebServices · Angular · Jira · .NET Framework · Maven · TypeScript · Bitbucket · Data Structures · Algorithms · Spring MVC · Tomcat · Spring Boot · Postman API · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Development · Front-end Development · C# · REST APIs · .NET Core · SQL · Git

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Served as the sole Android developer to build an Android app, onTime, from scratch.

- Developed user-friendly interfaces consistent with the iOS version by utilizing Android material components, the MVP architecture, and technologies including RxJava, Retrofit, Jsoup, and Parse SDK.

- Delivered the ride-hailing services by integrating Uber and Lyft APIs and nearby schedules by using Google Maps APIs.

- Delivered the location-based services by integrating Uber and Lyft APIs to provide users ride-hailing options and integrating Google Maps APIs to display schedules and traffic notifications.

- Integrated Google Analytics services for collecting user statistics and performance metrics.
positions.insights: Skills: Gradle · Java · RxJava · Data Structures · Algorithms · Android SDK · Mobile Application Development · Android Testing · Android · Software Development · Front-end Development · SQL · Git · Android Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development of platform security, Android app development, and web development.

- Implemented all platform security features on the Intel Moorefield chip which applies in Nokia’s N1 tablets.

- Developed a lightweight Android app running in the background to collect battery information.

- Collaborated on 2 web development projects with WebSocket and CSS3D integrations.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · JavaScript · HTML · Java · Mobile Application Development · LTE · C++ · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Software Development · Front-end Development · Android Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed mobile communication expertise in the development of 10+ Android phones with Qualcomm chipsets.
- Managed modem-side software issues in Android devices under GSM/GPRS, WCDMA and LTE networks, including identifying root causes and providing effective solutions, resolving fail test cases for GCF/PTCRB certifications, and designing experiments to verify new modem features.
- Implemented new software features, such as Engineer-Mode and Power-Boost tool in C/C++.
- Gave technical presentations on 3GPP Spec - 03.22, 05.02, 05.08, 44.018 (GSM/GPRS) and 36.321 (LTE).

Projects: ASUS Padfone series, Transformer TF700, Eee Pad Memo ME171

Technical Skills:
- Proficient in C/C++ coding.
- Considerable problem analysis experience in modem-side software issues.
- Solid domain knowledge in GSM, LTE, WCDMA, and RF driver.
- Familiar with Qualcomm analytical tools, including QXDM, QPST, and QSPR.
positions.insights: Skills: GSM · LTE · C++ · Software Development · Android Development
